summary: Iteration 57: Comprehensive testing of Advanced Accounting Module. Fixed critical MongoDB _id bug in accounting.py. All 24 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified working.

bug_fixed.issue: DuplicateKeyError: E11000 duplicate key error - _id: null when inserting documents
bug_fixed.root_cause: Code was using `insert_one({**doc, '_id': None})` which sets _id to null, causing duplicate key errors on subsequent inserts
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to `insert_one(doc)` and let MongoDB auto-generate _id, then pop _id from response
